title: About Me
introduction_text: My name is Fernando Rivera. I was born in 2007 in Comayagua, Honduras, and I’ve been drawn to technology for as long as I can remember. It all started the day I opened a random batch script full of commands I didn’t understand. Instead of ignoring it, I began experimenting, changing lines, breaking it, copying it, fixing it again. That process of trial and error hooked me. Since then, I’ve kept building, learning, and creating projects that satisfy my constant curiosity and need to understand how things work.
empowering_text: I don’t usually build the software people already use. I focus on teaching them how to actually use it well. And when the right tool doesn’t exist to solve a problem, I create it. I run workshops focused on practical software usage and improving digital literacy, making technology feel approachable instead of intimidating. I don’t care about someone’s background; what matters to me is helping them feel that spark—understanding that technology is a tool that can enhance whatever they do, whether it’s improving existing systems, empowering other fields, or even advancing technology itself.
founder_text1: Asterki Dev isn’t really a platform. It’s more like an extension of myself. The identity behind the workshops I run, the projects I build, and the people I help along the way.
